variantrule.name: Sanity
entries: Sanity serves as a way to track how your character has been affected by the horrors and traumas of their adventure. Each character has a Sanity Maximum (SM) that is determined upon character creation and rarely changes. At any given time your character's Sanity Points (SP) may be anywhere between 1 and their maximum. This will fluctuate with some degree of frequency, depending on their surroundings and choices. In general, anything upsetting, disturbing, or traumatic will decrease SP (and may rarely decrease your SM), while relaxing, positive, and fun actions will refresh any missing SP (and may rarely raise your SM).
Sanity Maximum Calculation:
Each character's sanity maximum is the sum of their intelligence, wisdom, and charisma scores.

item.name: Heart and Soul
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with these magic weapons

entries.name: Empathy Link
entries: These weapons are a physical manifestation of the creators' love for you. If you hold one of them in your hand and focus on an emotion, you can communicate that emotion to the creator across any distance as long as you are on the same plane. Similarly, the creators both have amulets that allow them to communicate their emotions to you, via these weapons.

entries.name: Heart's Kiss
entries: Once per round when damaging a creature with Heart, if you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, or if you have already damaged a creature with Soul you may trigger the following effect:
Heal {@dice 1d4} HP to yourself, and to another creature you can see within 30ft. Both of you also can add {@dice 1d4} to your next attack roll or saving throw.

entries.name: Soul's Reap
entries: Once per round when damaging a creature with Soul, if you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, or if you have already damaged a creature with Heart this round you may trigger the following effect:

Deal {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage to the creature, and to another creature you can see within 30ft. Both creatures must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC: 8+PB+Ability Mod used to make this attack) or subtract {@dice 1d4} from their next attack roll or saving throw.

item.name: All-Purpose Toy
entries: While holding this tool, you gain a +1 bonus to the spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your artificer spells.

entries.name: Vers
entries: This simple massager can transform into a variety of tools or toys; as an action, you can touch the item and transform it into any type of artisan's tool of your choice (see the "Equipment" chapter in the Player's Handbook for a list of {@item artisan's tools|XPHB}), or into any appendage or orifice of a creature you are familiar with.

entries.name: Reproductive
entries: Every day this toy can generate up to 25GP worth of potion materials. At least 4 hours must be spent working to turn these materials into a potion, or part of a potion. Only one potion can be worked on in this fashion at a time, and the materials disapear if unused at the end of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}

item.name: Paw of Protection
entries: While wearing this amulet, you gain a +1 bonus to the spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Paladin spells.

entries.name: Ancestral Protection
entries: Mechanics tbd

item.name: The Axis Mundi
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While holding this staff, you gain a +1 bonus to the spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Druid spells.

entries.name: The Land is with You
entries: While holding this staff and standing on the ground, the ground beneath you and the air 5ft around you becomes like the type of land chosen in your Circle of Land feature.
Up to 2 creatures within 5ft (including you) also gain the following benefits:

subclass.name: Oath of the Kitsune Ancestors
subclassFeatures: Oath of the Kitsune Ancestors|Paladin|XPHB|Kitsune Ancestors|Vytrys|3|Vytrys

subclassFeature.name: Tails' Tie
entries: Earth rises up around the target of your Divine Smite. The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

subclassFeature.name: Magic Burrow
entries: You {@variantrule Teleportation|XPHB|teleport} to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of yourself and take on a semi-incorporeal form, which lasts until the end of your next turn. While in this form, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions.

subclassFeature.name: Fox's Screech
entries: The target of your Divine Smite takes an extra {@damage 2d4} Thunder damage, and the sound jumps from the target to another creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The second creature also takes {@damage 2d4} Thunder damage.

subclassFeature.name: Elemental Smite
entries: Immediately after you cast {@spell Divine Smite|XPHB}, you can expend one use of your {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|XPHB|3|XPHB} and invoke one of the following effects.

subclassFeature.name: Genie Spells
entries: When you reach a Paladin level specified in the Genie Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Genie's Splendor
entries: When you aren't wearing any armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.
You also gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Performance|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: The Skulk's Surge
entries: The target of your Divine Smite and each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature is pushed 15 feet straight away from you and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of the Kitsune Ancestors
entries: {@i Brandish the Elemental Splendor of Genies}

Paladins sworn to the Oath of the Kitsune Ancestors revere the forces of the Elemental Planes. Through taking this oath, Paladins draw power from the four different types of genies—dao, masters of earth; djinn, masters of air; efreet, masters of fire; and marids, masters of water. In Faerûn, many Paladins who swear this oath hail from Calimshan, a land teeming with genies.
Paladins who swear this oath often undertake quests that take them all over the Realms and across the multiverse—including the Elemental Planes. These paladins share the following tenets:

items: Sow the seeds of creation amid the ashes of destruction.
Respect the elements, and fear their wrath.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Elemental Shielding
entries: Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. You and your allies have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage type while in your Aura of Protection.
At the start of each of your turns, you can change the damage type affected by this feature to one of the other listed options (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Elemental Rebuke
entries: When you are hit by an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to halve the attack's damage against yourself (round down) and force the attacker to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the attacker takes damage equal to {@dice 2d10} plus your Charisma modifier of one of the following types (your choice): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. On a successful save, the attacker takes half as much damage.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Noble Scion
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet and can hover.

entries.name: Minor Wish
entries: When you or an ally in your {@classFeature Aura of Protection|Paladin|XPHB|6|XPHB} fails a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make the {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} succeed instead.
